result:
I’d give people a deeper, more instinctive empathy—the ability to genuinely feel what others feel, not just understand it intellectually.

If everyone could momentarily experience the fears, hopes, pain, and joy of another person as if it were their own, I think a lot of cruelty, indifference, and division would become much harder to sustain. It wouldn’t solve every problem, but it would change the way we approach almost all of them.
